name: US Census Bureau Variables - Core Demographics
description: US Census Bureau core demographic variables including population counts, age distributions, race/ethnicity, education, poverty, and housing characteristics. This represents the most commonly used census variables. The temporal coverage for counties is: acs1 (2005-2022), acs5 (2007-2020), dec (2000, 2010, 2020). The temporal coverage for zctas is: acs5 (2009-2020), dec (2000, 2010, 2020). The variables are directly extracted from the census api using codes specified in the core.yaml configuration file at https://github.com/NSAPH-Data-Processing/us_census_time_series_extractor/tree/main/conf/variables.

content.{county, zcta}: String: 5-digit FIPS code or 5-digit ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA)
content.year: Int: Year of the census record. For acs1/acs5, the year is the middle year of the survey period. For dec, the year represents the decennial census year.
content.median_age: Float: Median age of the population
content.pop_black: Float: Black or African American population
content.pop_native: Float: American Indian and Alaska Native population
content.pop_higher_education_enrolled: Float: Population enrolled in higher education
content.pop_higher_education_attained: Float: Population with higher education degree
